request: Cover both generations, with each member’s personal history accessible. Modeli explicitly confirmed as a player character.
scope: First Called, connected early generation, changing Babel company and the later New Vanguard/Veilguard. Selected named statements, bounded scenes and existing reviewed histories; authored-message indexes are discovery aids, not exhaustive scene reading. Attachments and unseen combat are not reconstructed. The later Skylight Refuge supplement is reviewed separately in skylight-aftermath-review-2026-11-02.json.
authority: User canon and quest narration govern. Range/Gael/tavern conversations add compatible individual perspectives without overriding quest outcomes. First-arrival field notes and Ada’s remembered roster do not become a complete charter.

preservation: All old narrative/scene destinations and portraits/films remain.
No raw transcript, controller identity, protected origin, private payload or unseen media enters Git.
All timeline objects, dates, importance and regions remain exact; no added event or map pin.
specificLimits: Arjahn directly identifies as Vanguard; the earlier blanket uncertainty is narrowed. Formal ranks and complete roster remain unestablished.
Aravil is captured while trying to save Wren, later freed; Wren’s petrification is not a death.
Aerrow’s two hunt deaths, temporary Revivify and later restoration stay distinct.
Kumai’s hypotheticals are test answers, not atrocities carried out by candidates.
Modeli’s pride, anger, grief and fear remain his own experience; blaming himself does not settle responsibility for Serath’s death.
Claire’s promises do not establish a cure for Katherine. Keno/Force’s limited records do not acquire invented endings.
Pin/Pelagia/Pell remains the single Pelegia identity. Veilguard and Vanguard remain distinct.
Ryvyt’s death stays confirmed; a retrieval or completed revival is not invented.
